summary: Victim connected a Trust Wallet to a fraudulent dApp hosted on tronify.rent that claimed to provide cheaper Tron blockchain transactions. After connecting the wallet and authorizing the interaction, the malicious application drained approximately 2590 USDT from the wallet.
user_mistake: Connected a wallet to an unverified dApp and authorized wallet interaction
prevention: Research dApps before connecting wallets / Use a disposable wallet for untrusted applications
